steps.prompt_exact: I'm writing a character-heavy scene and need a self-contained continuity board I can save as an HTML file: characters, motives, relationship tension, scene beats, prior facts, contradiction checks, draggable beat cards, and an exportable handoff note for drafting the next scene.
steps.response_summary: Claude produced a complete single-file continuity board with characters, relationships, beats, facts, contradiction check, autosave, JSON export, and handoff note, but the implementation used inline handlers, innerHTML rendering, and scanner-visible modal API calls.

code_blocks.code:
◆Continuity Board

Characters

Want is what they chase; need is what the story makes them confront.

Relationship Tension

Track the live friction between two characters. Higher = closer to rupture.

Scene Beats

Drag the ⬍ grip to reorder. Each beat should change something.

Prior Established Facts

Lock 🔒 the ones that must not be contradicted.

Contradiction Check

For each beat, every prior fact that mentions a character in that beat is surfaced for you to verify. Locked facts are highlighted. You can also flag explicit conflicts.

Handoff Note

Auto-built from the board. Add open threads, then copy or download for drafting the next scene.
